summary: Declare per-host disk-free objectives with authored paths, admission floors and covered-capacity-time budgets, sampled natively on Linux and macOS.

replay.detail: No claim replay; measurements use the existing host-local native gauge ledger.

schema.detail: Adds the disk-free objective indicator with host, path and floor-bytes children. No claim registry, corpus or database schema change.

rules.detail: Only the authored host samples its filesystem. Floors and error-budget policy remain declarations; no admission policy is applied.

compatibility.detail: Upgrade sampling hosts before publishing disk-free declarations. Older declaration readers reject the unknown indicator. Existing objective syntax is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart only; restart gaps remain unknown.

manual.detail: Declare disk/HOST/NAME objectives with an absolute path, byte floor and budget. No built-in host roster or external collector is installed.

recovery.detail: Withdraw disk-free declarations before reverting sampling hosts. Existing ledger format remains readable by older binaries.
